disclaimer.en: FirstHour gives general guidance, not legal or financial advice. In an emergency, contact your bank, mobile network or the police directly.
disclaimer.sw: FirstHour hutoa mwongozo wa jumla, si ushauri wa kisheria au kifedha. Wakati wa dharura, wasiliana moja kwa moja na benki yako, kampuni ya simu au polisi.

title.sw: Simu ya wakala feki wa benki

description.en: Someone called pretending to be from your bank and asked for your details.
description.sw: Mtu alikupigia simu akijifanya kuwa wa benki yako na kuomba taarifa zako.

text.en: Has any money already left your account?
text.sw: Je, pesa yoyote imeshatoka kwenye akaunti yako?

label.en: No, or I am not sure

text.en: What did you share or do during the call?
text.sw: Ulishiriki nini au ulifanya nini wakati wa simu hiyo?

label.en: I shared card or account details, a PIN, a password or an OTP code
label.sw: Nilitoa maelezo ya kadi au akaunti, PIN, nenosiri au msimbo wa OTP

label.en: I installed an app or gave remote access to my phone
label.sw: Nilipakua programu au nilitoa ufikiaji wa mbali wa simu yangu

label.en: I only talked and shared nothing

title.en: Act now: money has left your account
title.sw: Chukua hatua sasa: pesa zimetoka kwenye akaunti yako

steps.en: Call your bank right now using the official number on your card or on the bank's official website. Do not call any number the caller gave you.
steps.sw: Piga simu benki yako sasa hivi kwa nambari rasmi iliyo kwenye kadi yako au tovuti rasmi ya benki. Usipige nambari yoyote uliyopewa na aliyekupigia.

steps.en: Tell them the transactions were not authorised by you. Ask them to block your card and online banking, and to try to stop or recall the transfers.
steps.sw: Waambie kuwa miamala hiyo haikuidhinishwa na wewe. Waombe wazuie kadi yako na huduma za benki mtandaoni, na wajaribu kusimamisha au kurejesha uhamisho huo.

steps.en: Change your card PIN, online banking password and mobile banking PIN. Use a different phone if you think yours may be compromised.
steps.sw: Badilisha PIN ya kadi yako, nenosiri la benki mtandaoni na PIN ya benki kwa simu. Tumia simu nyingine ikiwa unashuku yako imedukuliwa.

steps.en: Save evidence before it is deleted: your call log, the caller's number, bank alerts and your statement.
steps.sw: Hifadhi ushahidi kabla haujafutwa: orodha ya simu ulizopokea, nambari ya aliyepiga, ujumbe wa benki na taarifa ya akaunti yako.

steps.en: Ask the bank for a reference number for your report and write it down.
steps.sw: Omba benki nambari ya kumbukumbu ya ripoti yako na uiandike.

steps.en: Report to the police or the DCI cybercrime unit and ask for an OB or reference number.
steps.sw: Ripoti kwa polisi au kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI na uombe nambari ya OB au ya kumbukumbu.

report_to.en: Your bank's fraud desk
report_to.sw: Idara ya udanganyifu ya benki yako

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.en: Caller's phone number and time of the call
evidence.sw: Nambari ya aliyepiga na muda wa simu

evidence.en: Screenshots of bank alerts and statements
evidence.sw: Picha za skrini za ujumbe wa benki na taarifa ya akaunti

evidence.en: Transaction IDs, amounts and dates
evidence.sw: Nambari za miamala, kiasi na tarehe

evidence.en: The bank's reference number
evidence.sw: Nambari ya kumbukumbu ya benki

title.en: Secure your account before money is taken
title.sw: Linda akaunti yako kabla pesa hazijaibwa

steps.en: Call your bank now on the official number from your card or the bank's website and tell them you shared your details with a fake agent.
steps.sw: Piga simu benki yako sasa kwa nambari rasmi kutoka kwenye kadi yako au tovuti ya benki na uwaambie ulitoa taarifa zako kwa wakala feki.

steps.en: Ask them to block or replace your card and reset your online and mobile banking access.
steps.sw: Waombe wazuie au wabadilishe kadi yako na kuweka upya huduma zako za benki mtandaoni na kwa simu.

steps.en: Change your PINs and passwords. If you reuse a password anywhere else, change it there too.
steps.sw: Badilisha PIN na nenosiri zako. Ikiwa unatumia nenosiri hilo hilo mahali pengine, libadilishe pia.

steps.en: Turn on transaction alerts and check your statement for transactions you do not recognise.
steps.sw: Washa arifa za miamala na uangalie taarifa ya akaunti yako kama kuna miamala usiyoitambua.

steps.en: Never share an OTP, PIN or password with anyone. A real bank will never ask for them.
steps.sw: Usimpe mtu yeyote msimbo wa OTP, PIN au nenosiri. Benki halisi haitawahi kuviomba.

steps.en: Report the caller's number to your bank and to the police or DCI.
steps.sw: Ripoti nambari ya aliyepiga kwa benki yako na kwa polisi au DCI.

report_to.en: Your bank's fraud desk
report_to.sw: Idara ya udanganyifu ya benki yako

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.en: Caller's phone number and time of the call
evidence.sw: Nambari ya aliyepiga na muda wa simu

evidence.en: A written note of exactly what you shared
evidence.sw: Maelezo yaliyoandikwa ya kile ulichotoa hasa

evidence.en: The bank's reference number
evidence.sw: Nambari ya kumbukumbu ya benki

title.en: Cut off the attacker's access to your phone
title.sw: Kata ufikiaji wa mdukuzi kwenye simu yako

steps.en: Turn on airplane mode or switch off Wi-Fi and mobile data right now to disconnect the attacker.
steps.sw: Washa hali ya ndege au zima Wi-Fi na data ya simu sasa hivi ili kumkatia mdukuzi mawasiliano.

steps.en: Uninstall the app you were told to install (check Settings, then Apps). Remote access apps such as AnyDesk or TeamViewer are common in this scam.
steps.sw: Ondoa programu uliyoambiwa upakue (angalia Mipangilio, kisha Programu). Programu za ufikiaji wa mbali kama AnyDesk au TeamViewer hutumika sana katika ulaghai huu.

steps.en: From a different phone, call your bank on its official number. Ask them to block your card, online banking and mobile banking.
steps.sw: Ukitumia simu nyingine, piga benki yako kwa nambari yake rasmi. Waombe wazuie kadi yako, benki mtandaoni na benki kwa simu.

steps.en: Change your bank, email and mobile money passwords and PINs from a clean device, not from the affected phone.
steps.sw: Badilisha nenosiri na PIN za benki, barua pepe na pesa za simu ukitumia kifaa safi, si simu iliyoathirika.

steps.en: Consider a factory reset of the phone, and back up only photos and contacts first.
steps.sw: Fikiria kurejesha simu kwenye mipangilio ya kiwandani, na uhifadhi picha na namba za simu pekee kwanza.

steps.en: Check your statements for unknown transactions and report everything to the police or DCI.
steps.sw: Angalia taarifa za akaunti kwa miamala usiyoitambua na uripoti kila kitu kwa polisi au DCI.

report_to.sw: Idara ya udanganyifu ya benki yako

report_to.en: Your mobile money provider
report_to.sw: Mtoa huduma wako wa pesa za simu

report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.sw: Jina la programu iliyopakuliwa

title.en: You avoided the scam: now stay safe
title.sw: Umeepuka ulaghai: sasa endelea kuwa salama

steps.en: End the call. Do not call back any number the caller gave you.
steps.sw: Maliza simu. Usipige tena nambari yoyote uliyopewa na aliyekupigia.

steps.en: If you want to be sure, call your bank on the official number from your card or website and ask if they contacted you.
steps.sw: Ikiwa unataka kuwa na uhakika, piga benki yako kwa nambari rasmi kutoka kwenye kadi yako au tovuti na uulize kama waliwasiliana nawe.

steps.en: Block the number and report it to your mobile network and to the police or DCI.
steps.sw: Zuia nambari hiyo na uiripoti kwa kampuni yako ya simu na kwa polisi au DCI.

steps.en: Warn family and friends about this scam, especially older relatives.
steps.sw: Waonye familia na marafiki kuhusu ulaghai huu, hasa wazee.

report_to.en: Your mobile network
report_to.sw: Kampuni yako ya simu

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.sw: Nambari ya aliyepiga na muda wa simu

description.en: You sent money to someone and now believe it was a scam.
description.sw: Ulituma pesa kwa mtu na sasa unaamini ulikuwa ulaghai.

text.en: How did you send the money?

label.en: M-Pesa or another mobile money service
label.sw: M-Pesa au huduma nyingine ya pesa za simu

label.en: Airtime, gift cards, crypto or something else
label.sw: Muda wa maongezi, kadi za zawadi, sarafu za kidijitali au kitu kingine

title.en: Act within minutes: mobile money sent to a scammer
title.sw: Chukua hatua ndani ya dakika chache: pesa za simu zimetumwa kwa tapeli

steps.en: Contact your mobile money provider immediately through its official customer care channel and report the transaction. Speed matters.
steps.sw: Wasiliana na mtoa huduma wako wa pesa za simu mara moja kupitia njia yake rasmi ya huduma kwa wateja na uripoti muamala huo. Kasi ni muhimu.

steps.en: Ask whether the transaction can be reversed or the recipient's account restricted. A reversal is not guaranteed.
steps.sw: Uliza kama muamala unaweza kurejeshwa au akaunti ya mpokeaji kuzuiwa. Kurejeshwa hakuhakikishwi.

steps.en: Keep the confirmation message with the transaction code. Do not delete it.
steps.sw: Hifadhi ujumbe wa uthibitisho wenye msimbo wa muamala. Usiufute.

steps.en: Stop talking to the scammer and do not send any more money, even for 'fees to recover your money'. That is a second scam.
steps.sw: Acha kuongea na tapeli na usitume pesa zaidi, hata kwa 'ada ya kurejesha pesa zako'. Huo ni ulaghai wa pili.

steps.en: Block the scammer's number and report it to your provider.
steps.sw: Zuia nambari ya tapeli na uiripoti kwa mtoa huduma wako.

steps.en: Report to the police or the DCI and ask for an OB or reference number.
steps.sw: Ripoti kwa polisi au DCI na uombe nambari ya OB au ya kumbukumbu.

report_to.en: Your mobile money provider
report_to.sw: Mtoa huduma wako wa pesa za simu

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.en: Transaction confirmation message and code
evidence.sw: Ujumbe wa uthibitisho wa muamala na msimbo

evidence.en: Scammer's number and name shown on the transaction
evidence.sw: Nambari ya tapeli na jina lililoonekana kwenye muamala

evidence.en: Screenshots of calls, SMS and chats
evidence.sw: Picha za skrini za simu, SMS na mazungumzo

evidence.en: Amount, date and time
evidence.sw: Kiasi, tarehe na saa

title.en: Act now: bank transfer sent to a scammer
title.sw: Chukua hatua sasa: uhamisho wa benki umetumwa kwa tapeli

steps.en: Call your bank immediately on its official number and report the transfer as fraud.
steps.sw: Piga benki yako mara moja kwa nambari yake rasmi na uripoti uhamisho huo kama ulaghai.

steps.en: Give them the recipient's account name, number and bank, the amount, and the time. Ask them to recall or freeze the funds if possible.
steps.sw: Wape jina la akaunti ya mpokeaji, nambari na benki, kiasi na muda. Waombe warudishe au wazuie pesa hizo ikiwezekana.

steps.en: Ask for a reference number for your report and write it down.
steps.sw: Omba nambari ya kumbukumbu ya ripoti yako na uiandike.

steps.en: Stop all contact with the scammer and send no more money.
steps.sw: Acha mawasiliano yote na tapeli na usitume pesa zaidi.

steps.en: Report to the police or the DCI and ask for an OB or reference number.
steps.sw: Ripoti kwa polisi au DCI na uombe nambari ya OB au ya kumbukumbu.

report_to.en: Your bank's fraud desk
report_to.sw: Idara ya udanganyifu ya benki yako

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.en: Transfer receipt or confirmation
evidence.sw: Risiti au uthibitisho wa uhamisho

evidence.en: Recipient account details
evidence.sw: Maelezo ya akaunti ya mpokeaji

evidence.en: Chats, calls and messages with the scammer
evidence.sw: Mazungumzo, simu na ujumbe na tapeli

evidence.en: The bank's reference number
evidence.sw: Nambari ya kumbukumbu ya benki

title.en: Act quickly: other payment sent to a scammer
title.sw: Chukua hatua haraka: malipo mengine yametumwa kwa tapeli

steps.en: Keep all proof: receipts, gift card codes, wallet addresses and screenshots.
steps.sw: Hifadhi ushahidi wote: risiti, misimbo ya kadi za zawadi, anwani za pochi na picha za skrini.

steps.en: Contact the company or platform you paid through (the airtime provider, gift card issuer or crypto exchange) straight away and report the fraud.
steps.sw: Wasiliana mara moja na kampuni au jukwaa ulilolipia (mtoa huduma wa muda wa maongezi, mtoaji wa kadi ya zawadi au soko la sarafu za kidijitali) na uripoti ulaghai.

steps.en: Stop all contact with the scammer and do not pay anything more.
steps.sw: Acha mawasiliano yote na tapeli na usilipe chochote zaidi.

steps.en: Report to the police or the DCI and ask for an OB or reference number.
steps.sw: Ripoti kwa polisi au DCI na uombe nambari ya OB au ya kumbukumbu.

report_to.en: The company or platform you paid through
report_to.sw: Kampuni au jukwaa ulilolipia

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu

evidence.en: Receipts, codes and wallet addresses
evidence.sw: Risiti, misimbo na anwani za pochi

evidence.en: Screenshots of conversations
evidence.sw: Picha za skrini za mazungumzo

evidence.en: Amount, date and time
evidence.sw: Kiasi, tarehe na saa

description.en: Someone took over your WhatsApp, social media or email account, often through a link.
description.sw: Mtu amechukua akaunti yako ya WhatsApp, mitandao ya kijamii au barua pepe, mara nyingi kupitia kiungo.

label.sw: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok au kama hizo

title.en: Take back your WhatsApp and protect your contacts
title.sw: Rudisha WhatsApp yako na uwalinde watu wako

steps.en: Open WhatsApp (or reinstall it) and sign in with your phone number. WhatsApp will send a 6-digit code by SMS or call. Never share this code with anyone.
steps.sw: Fungua WhatsApp (au iweke upya) na uingie kwa nambari yako ya simu. WhatsApp itatuma msimbo wa tarakimu 6 kwa SMS au simu. Usimpe mtu yeyote msimbo huu.

steps.en: If you are asked for a two-step verification PIN that you did not set, use the 'Forgot PIN' option and follow the instructions, or use the in-app help option to contact WhatsApp support.
steps.sw: Ukiombwa PIN ya uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili ambayo hukuiweka, tumia chaguo la 'Umesahau PIN' na ufuate maelekezo, au tumia chaguo la msaada ndani ya programu kuwasiliana na msaada wa WhatsApp.

steps.en: Once you are back in, open Settings, then Linked devices, and log out of every device you do not recognise.
steps.sw: Ukishaingia, fungua Mipangilio, kisha Vifaa vilivyounganishwa, na utoke kwenye kila kifaa usichokitambua.

steps.en: Turn on two-step verification (Settings, Account, Two-step verification) and add a recovery email.
steps.sw: Washa uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili (Mipangilio, Akaunti, Uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili) na uweke barua pepe ya kurejesha akaunti.

steps.en: Warn your contacts and groups right away that your account was hacked and that they should ignore any money requests or links sent from it.
steps.sw: Waonye watu wako na makundi yako mara moja kuwa akaunti yako ilidukuliwa na wapuuze maombi yoyote ya pesa au viungo vilivyotumwa kutoka kwake.

steps.en: Do not click the link again. Change the password of any account that uses the same password as the one you may have entered.
steps.sw: Usibofye kiungo hicho tena. Badilisha nenosiri la akaunti yoyote inayotumia nenosiri sawa na ulilokuwa umeingiza.

steps.en: If a contact sent money because of a message from your account, tell them to report it to their bank or mobile money provider immediately.
steps.sw: Ikiwa mtu alituma pesa kwa sababu ya ujumbe kutoka kwenye akaunti yako, mwambie aripoti mara moja kwa benki yake au mtoa huduma wake wa pesa za simu.

report_to.en: WhatsApp support (in-app help)
report_to.sw: Msaada wa WhatsApp (ndani ya programu)

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station if money was lost
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ikiwa pesa zilipotea

evidence.en: The link or message that was clicked
evidence.sw: Kiungo au ujumbe uliobofya

evidence.en: Screenshots of messages the attacker sent to your contacts
evidence.sw: Picha za skrini za ujumbe mdukuzi aliotuma kwa watu wako

evidence.en: Names and numbers of contacts who lost money
evidence.sw: Majina na nambari za watu waliopoteza pesa

title.sw: Rudisha akaunti yako ya mitandao ya kijamii

steps.en: Use the platform's official 'hacked account' or 'forgot password' recovery page from a device you trust.
steps.sw: Tumia ukurasa rasmi wa urejeshaji wa 'akaunti iliyodukuliwa' au 'nimesahau nenosiri' wa jukwaa hilo kutoka kifaa unachokiamini.

steps.en: Once you are back in, set a new strong password and log out of all other sessions and devices.
steps.sw: Ukishaingia, weka nenosiri jipya imara na utoke kwenye vipindi na vifaa vingine vyote.

steps.en: Check that your recovery email and phone number have not been changed. Remove anything you do not recognise.
steps.sw: Hakikisha barua pepe na nambari ya simu ya kurejesha akaunti havijabadilishwa. Ondoa chochote usichokitambua.

steps.en: Turn on two-factor authentication, preferably with an authenticator app instead of SMS.
steps.sw: Washa uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili, ikiwezekana kwa programu ya uthibitishaji badala ya SMS.

steps.en: Remove unknown apps connected to your account and warn your followers and friends not to trust messages sent while it was hacked.
steps.sw: Ondoa programu usizozijua zilizounganishwa na akaunti yako na uwaonye wafuasi na marafiki wasiamini ujumbe uliotumwa wakati ilipodukuliwa.

report_to.en: The platform's support or report-hacked-account page
report_to.sw: Msaada wa jukwaa au ukurasa wa kuripoti akaunti iliyodukuliwa

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station if money or identity was involved
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ikiwa pesa au utambulisho uliathirika

evidence.en: Screenshots of the suspicious link, messages and posts
evidence.sw: Picha za skrini za kiungo cha kutiliwa shaka, ujumbe na machapisho

evidence.en: Login alerts or emails from the platform
evidence.sw: Arifa za kuingia au barua pepe kutoka kwa jukwaa

title.en: Secure your email first: it unlocks your other accounts
title.sw: Linda barua pepe yako kwanza: inafungua akaunti zako nyingine

steps.en: Reset your email password using the provider's official recovery page, then sign out of all other sessions and devices.
steps.sw: Weka upya nenosiri la barua pepe yako kupitia ukurasa rasmi wa urejeshaji wa mtoa huduma, kisha utoke kwenye vipindi na vifaa vingine vyote.

steps.en: Turn on two-step verification for the email account.
steps.sw: Washa uthibitishaji wa hatua mbili kwa akaunti ya barua pepe.

steps.en: Check the settings for forwarding rules, filters and recovery email or phone. Remove anything you did not set up.
steps.sw: Angalia mipangilio ya kusambaza barua, vichujio na barua pepe au simu ya kurejesha akaunti. Ondoa chochote ambacho hukukiweka.

steps.en: Change the passwords of accounts linked to this email, starting with banking, mobile money and social media.
steps.sw: Badilisha nenosiri za akaunti zilizounganishwa na barua pepe hii, ukianza na benki, pesa za simu na mitandao ya kijamii.

steps.en: Check your bank and mobile money statements for unknown activity and report any fraud to the provider immediately.
steps.sw: Angalia taarifa za benki na pesa za simu kwa shughuli zisizojulikana na uripoti ulaghai wowote kwa mtoa huduma mara moja.

report_to.en: Your email provider's support
report_to.sw: Msaada wa mtoa huduma wako wa barua pepe

report_to.en: DCI cybercrime unit or the nearest police station if money or identity was involved
report_to.sw: Kitengo cha uhalifu wa mtandaoni cha DCI au kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu ikiwa pesa au utambulisho uliathirika

evidence.en: Security alert emails and login notifications
evidence.sw: Barua pepe za tahadhari za usalama na arifa za kuingia

evidence.en: Screenshots of unknown forwarding rules or sent messages
evidence.sw: Picha za skrini za kanuni za kusambaza usizozijua au ujumbe uliotumwa
